name: 159-policy-message-keeps-raw-url
old:
f"URL host {hostname!r} resolves to private/special address {ip} "
                    f"(block_private_networks=true): {_mask_policy_url(url)}"
new:
f"URL host {hostname!r} resolves to private/special address {ip} "
                    f"(block_private_networks=true): {url}"
rationale: 把 blockPrivateNetworks 的 URLPolicyError 消息还原成原始 URL：明文随异常对象被 str(err) 折进 NodeException/NodeExecutionError——r2 finding 的原形。AST 守卫第二腿负责在生产源码层面判红；直接调用策略判定（不经 NodeException 的文本清洗层）时动态面也重红。
